item.title: First Watch CFO, who guided $1.2B company's IPO, to retire
item.description: First Watch Chief Financial Officer Mel Hope will retire from the east Manatee County-based daytime dining company, where he has worked for nearly eight years. His retirement will take place later this year. Hope's career has spanned more than 40 years. He joined First Watch in 2018, after serving as CFO of Popeye’s Louisiana Kitchen. item.title: Tampa casino names new president
item.description: There’s a new president in charge at the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino in Tampa — one in a slew of new appointments Seminole Gaming and Hard Rock International made across the country this month. According to a release, Travis Lunn, 52, has been named the president of the organization’s Tampa hotel and casino. item.title: Fort Myers senior living facility gets new operator
item.description: American House Senior Living Communities has added a property to its already bulging portfolio. This one is in Fort Myers.The Michigan company has taken over the management of what was formerly known as The Palms of Fort Myers and rebranded it American House The Palms.The community is owned by Ventas Inc., which bought it in January. item.description: Weeks after a California hedge fund made an unsolicited offer to buy the company for $1.1 billion cash, MarineMax has been thrust into a public sparring match with both its potential buyer and shareholders urging the company to accept the deal. item.title: Orlando company acquires Sarasota dental lab
item.description: An Orlando-based manufacturer of dental products has acquired a Sarasota dental lab; Standard Dental Labs has purchased Brlit Dental Lab. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.Brlit Dental Lab — based at 4232 McIntosh Lane, off Bee Ridge near McIntosh roads — specializes in making crowns, bridges, implants, dentures, partials and appliance repairs. item.title: Discount airline using Lakeland as a hub extends 10-city route network
item.description: Budget-friendly Avelo Airlines announced plans Wednesday to extend its flight schedule in multiple parts of Florida, including four airports in the region.The airline said its extending what it called its Central Florida flight schedule through mid-November 2026. item.title: Sarasota IT firm focused on higher ed merges with Texas company
item.description: Sarasota tech consulting firm CampusWorks has merged with Austin, Texas-based technology company Dynamic Campus. Both entities serve institutions of higher education. Financial terms of the deal were not disclosed.Based on Clark Road, CampusWorks provides strategy and technology services to higher education institutions to improve organizational effectiveness and enhance the student experience. item.title: Naples chamber creates micro businesses council
item.description: The Greater Naples Chamber of Commerce has launched an initiative to support what it calls “ the smallest but most foundational businesses in Collier County.” Dubbed the Micro Business Council, the program is specifically for micro-enterprises with one to 10 employees, the chamber says in a statement. item.title: DogPerfect opens north Manatee store, begins franchising
item.description: A new shop for dogs has opened in north Manatee County. DogPerfect recently began welcoming four-legged customers and their people to its new store at 11667 Moccasin Wallow Road in Parrish.Located near the master-planned community of North River Ranch, DogPerfect sells curated nutrition and enrichment products and offers professional grooming services.
